program='''def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two binary panels; mark cells active in both."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    separators = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != 0]
    if len(separators) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected one solid nonzero separator column")
    c = separators[0]
    left, right = c, w - c - 1
    if left != right:
        raise ValueError("expected equal-width panels")
    return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][c + 1 + j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(left)] for r in range(h)]
'''
